name: Anti-Dandruff & Hair Fall Kit
subtitle: Controls dandruff, dryness & hair fall
description: Dandruff, dryness & hair fall often go hand-in-hand. A dry scalp can weaken roots and lead to breakage. Be Bodywise Anti-Dandruff & Hair Strength Kit gently clears flakes, restores hydration, and strengthens hair from within. What does it contain? ➡️ 1% ZPTO Anti-Dandruff Shampoo : Fights dandruff-causing microbes, soothes dryness & restores scalp hydration with its dual-action formula ➡️ Hair Health Gummies : A daily boost of Biotin, Iron, and Zinc to support stronger hair from within Results you can expect: ➔ Month 1: Noticeably reduces flakes & scalp dryness ➔ Month 2: Reduced hair fall & improved scalp hydration ➔ Month 3+: Long-term flake control & noticeable reduction in hair fall 📅 Tested on Indian women. Visible results with consistent use.
usage: ✨ Consistency matters. Science that sets you free. 1% ZPTO Anti-Dandruff Shampoo (200ml) Apply to wet hair and massage into the scalp. Leave it on for 2-3 minutes then rinse thoroughly with water. Hair Health Gummies Take 1 gummy daily after a meal.

list.title: Important Information
list.content: If you are pregnant, we recommend consulting your healthcare professional before taking not just this supplement, but any supplement.  For nursing mothers, you can use these: <link of postpartum gummies> Made with biotin and other multivitamins, these supplements help strengthen your hair and ensure hair growth. However, it is not an immediate solution and results take up to 3 months to show. It is effective when consumed daily; to continue well after the 3-4 month period if you wish to or can be replaced with a nutrient rich diet.

list.title: Can this be used for sensitive scalp?
list.content: We recommend doing a patch test before using the product

list.title: Is it safe for pregnant women to take a biotin supplement?
list.content: If you are pregnant or nursing, consult your healthcare professional before taking any supplement
